description: This file defines a template class 'optional' similar to std::experimental::optional, providing optional value semantics with methods for managing an internal object of type T, including construction, assignment, and comparison operators. It also includes related types nullopt_t and in_place_t, and integrates with the std namespace for hash and swap functions.

classes.name: optional
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an optional value of type T, allowing for presence or absence of a value with various utility methods.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Conversion operator to check if the optional contains a value.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Dereference operator to access the internal object.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator to access the internal object.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the contained object, with debug check for engagement.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two optional objects.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Private method to initialize the optional with a value.

methods.name: EnsureDisengaged
methods.description: Private method to destruct the contained object and mark optional as disengaged.
